integrity: Proof relies on a standard finite prefix automaton and a matrix-logarithm identity; finite exact-rational tests are not represented as an infinite proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Single specified word in an iid finite-alphabet source; no assertion for unions of words, Markov-dependent sources or general phase-type laws. Matrix-trace jumps are exact but may not have closed forms. Unindexed classical literature remains a possible originality risk.
title: Exact compound-Poisson law for the excess first-occurrence time of every iid word
